request.text_prompt: Create original cold cinematic science-fiction game audio, approximately 8 seconds. A retreating spacecraft engine under steady heavy thrust, sustained mechanical energy. Electric drive whine layered with soft repeating power-converter pulses. Maintain a consistent sound bed from beginning to end with slow natural variation, no opening hit or final cadence; suitable for seamless crossfaded looping. No vocals, singing, humming, speech, narration, lyrics or spoken prompt. No clipping, harsh distortion or unrelated scene sounds. No music, melody or soundtrack.
